title: TendingPolicyPayload
description: Source of truth: this schema IS the authoritative shape for Manifest{kind: 'tending-policy'} payload_json. Authored as a DHT Manifest entry via create_manifest (existing coordinator). The substrate reads this payload to qualify attention-tending writes and feed the T16 CollectiveFilterPattern aggregation. Category A (Notarized) via existing Manifest entry type. No new DHT entry type needed.

floor.description: Constitutional tending-immune floor — classes that attention-tending filters may never silence. Must contain all five tending-immune classes. Mirrors TENDING_IMMUNE_CLASSES in content_store_integrity/src/manifest.rs.

dwell_qualification_ms.description: Minimum elapsed time in milliseconds before an attention-tending entry is considered a qualified view. The substrate enforces this at coordinator time (create_attention_tending). Client sends elapsed_ms; the coordinator compares against this policy value. Default: 3000. Retiring F-POLICY-4 client constant DWELL_THRESHOLD_MS = 3000.

min_ttl_seconds.description: Minimum TTL in seconds for AttentionTending entries. The integrity zome already enforces a hard floor of 3600 (1 hour); this policy field may set a higher collective minimum. Default: 3600.

allowed_classifications.description: Permitted classification values for AttentionTending entries in this collective context. When omitted, all classifications are permitted. Items must match the enum defined in the integrity zome.

collective_k_threshold.description: Minimum agent count (k) required before T16 emits a CollectiveFilterPattern aggregate. Ensures k-anonymity — individual attention signals are never published. Default: 5.
